title: Quiz Count At Least
prompt: A quiz dashboard receives quiz scores. Write a function that returns how many values are greater than or equal to the minimum score.

explanation.beginner:
Example: quizCountAtLeast([72,88,91,64], 80) produces 2. The result must follow this precise rule: A quiz dashboard receives quiz scores. Write a function that returns how many values are greater than or equal to the minimum score. Work with one argument at a time and distinguish the values that select a branch from the values returned by that branch.

Compare “returns zero when none qualify”: input [[48,49],80] produces 0. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
